description:
A group of aspiring scientists with questionable brain-cell distribution and an unhealthy amount of confidence. Our calculations defy logic, our experiments defy expectations, and our collective intelligence is yet to be detected by any satellite.

We don't break the laws of physics. We simply fail to understand them.

Mission: Reach the stars.
Vision: Survive the landing.
Status: Currently Investigated By NASA

Houston we have a problem, oh wait, I mean we are the problem.
summary:
Opportunity: The Story of a Machine, a Planet, and the True Nature of Exploring
This ten-part tale covers NASA’s Opportunity rover from the start of its journey to Mars in 2003 until the quiet end of its mission in 2019. Using historical detail, scientific discoveries, and imaginative philosophic storytelling, the project gives readers an account of the life of a machine meant to discover something about another world. It encourages reflection upon the true nature of exploring.
On the journey through Opportunity’s life cycle, readers will learn more about the technology behind NASA’s space robot – the mobility system of the Mars rover, its scientific equipment, its solar batteries, and the communications network. In addition, it will be shown how Opportunity helped prove the existence of the signs of ancient water on the planet and how far it travelled past its originally planned course.
The project aims to explore NASA’s space technology as part of humanity’s efforts to learn about the solar system. Science made accessible to children.
details: This project tells the story of the journey of NASA's Mars rover Opportunity and its remarkable journey on the Martian surface. It explores the mission's major events, discoveries, challenges faced, and the unexpected long life of a machine built to last for only 90 days.The aim of the project is to make space exploration more accessible and interesting to people through storytelling while at the same time incorporating scientific facts. In addition to sharing the information, it makes the reader think about such issues as purpose, perseverance, and human ingenuity.The narrative is created using various digital research tools, articles published by NASA, peer-reviewed scientific articles, and word processing software; no special hardware or programming languages are used.The creativity of the project lies in its method of sharing scientific facts. Instead of just listing the facts, the events are described in narrative form. Throughout the process, the main focus is made on factual accuracy and readability.
